title: Passwordless & Phishing-Resistant MFA with FIDO2 Security Keys
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (phishing-resistant credential program across Entra ID auth methods, FIDO2 keys, Conditional Access enforcement; higher assurance/federal context).
Distinct from windows-hello-for-business (the WHfB enrollment product): this product centers on passwordless + FIDO2 hardware security keys and phishing-resistant MFA enforcement.
hook: Go passwordless with phishing-resistant credentials — FIDO2 keys and Windows Hello
problem: Passwords (and even push-based MFA) are still being phished and bombed. Federal and security-conscious organizations are required to move to phishing-resistant, passwordless authentication. This solution stands up passwordless and phishing-resistant MFA in Microsoft Entra ID — FIDO2 hardware security keys, Windows Hello for Business, and (where applicable) certificate-based authentication — enabled as authentication methods, registered by users, and enforced through Conditional Access authentication strengths so weak methods can no longer get in.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — what phishing-resistant, passwordless authentication is, the Entra ID authentication methods model, FIDO2 security keys vs. Windows Hello for Business vs. certificate-based auth, and Conditional Access authentication strengths.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Entra ID licensing, authentication methods policy, FIDO2 key support/provisioning, registration campaign, Conditional Access) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: enable the authentication methods, provision/register FIDO2 keys and Windows Hello, run a registration campaign, create a phishing-resistant authentication strength, enforce it via Conditional Access, then pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — auth-methods readiness discovery, per-user passwordless registration validation, a tenant credential-method and coverage report, safe remediation of weak-method users, and a target group builder for the rollout.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: Stand up passwordless and phishing-resistant MFA in Microsoft Entra ID — FIDO2 security keys, Windows Hello for Business, and certificate-based auth, enforced via Conditional Access authentication strengths. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
